source_locations.finding: cell_intensity is exposure × community × sigmoid(profile turnout logit); eventG scales event intensity and observed/unobserved event branch uses Gamma event scale; response is contest-level scalar from baseline + race effect.

selected IID choice provider assigns per-candidate other effects (Normal(-3,1) except sole-other case) and softmaxes candidate utilities per profile; separate RoleChoice provider enables role hierarchy but is not selected in A2018.

single-mark category probabilities are candidate response × candidate softmax plus (1-response) × a noncandidate-category simplex; rates aggregate cell intensity × categories and are eventG scaled; each official count-vector observation has one Poisson factor over its included candidate/noncandidate categories.

survey-row likelihoods use source-specific turnout/choice/response emission; participation reports use NegativeBinomial on event_intensity; ordinary poll means are log candidate category-rate ratios; ranked-channel polls use a separate emission path.
Arizona target has 20 major-pair poll rows and no target survey/count/report factor; write-in score is candidate marks, not turnout; profile aggregation permits indirect coupling.

synthetic allocation consumes supplied other_mass, writein_fraction, utilities, eligibility, scalar response, and complete noncandidate simplex; it emits category probabilities and expected marks, not a fitted likelihood.
synthetic integer eligible cell counts and caller-supplied shared scenarios; rationalizes internal scenario mixture; conditional cell-binomial moments and shared-scenario covariance only.

factorial_comparison.baseline: selected IID choice + native profile participation/event scale
factorial_comparison.candidate_only: learned role-level mass followed by within-role choice; retain the same scalar response and native participation path
factorial_comparison.participation_only: one finite-population participation law that replaces the competing native q/eventG scale path; retain native candidate allocation and scalar response
factorial_comparison.combined: the same role-level allocation and same single participation replacement
all_arms_require: same priors except preregistered changed layers
same target set and measurement ledger
same parent identities and protected 0.125 masses
limitations: 2018 AZ and Nevada 2022 outcomes are exposed development targets
no fitted comparator or independent heldout score exists in this packet
data-unit/source overlap and integer-eligibility contract remain prerequisites

no_claims: no claim that the prototypes are composable as written
